def wrap(text, width):
    lines = []
    cur = ""
    for w in text.split():
        extra = len(w) + (1 if cur else 0)
        print(f"DEBUG: w={repr(w)}, cur={repr(cur)}, extra={extra}, len(cur)+extra={len(cur)+extra}")
        if len(cur) + extra > width:
            lines.append(cur)
            print(f"  -> appending {repr(cur)} to lines")
            cur = w
        else:
            cur = f"{cur} {w}" if cur else w
            print(f"  -> updating cur to {repr(cur)}")
    if cur:
        lines.append(cur)
        print(f"-> appending {repr(cur)} to lines at end")
    return lines

print("Result:", wrap('aaa bbb ccc', 7))
EOF
